route: minimal exact ABL1 reader fallback-status versus sentinel check

semantics.first_stage: status=0 enters 0x2002 then advances index at 0x200E; status=1 requires returned byte==1 to advance; returned byte!=1 returns failure at 0x209A
semantics.final_stage: status=0 returns failure at 0x2094; status=1 enters typed guards; sentinel/Auto value fails typed guard and returns 0 at 0x209A without trying another descriptor
semantics.type2: returned 0xFFFF with r7=0 is rejected by ~value/UXTH/ORR guard before STRH; no fallback branch exists in this slice
semantics.precedence: ordered chain is not combined-key fallback on arbitrary values: earlier elements are boolean gate/status stages, and the final element is the typed value stage
semantics.callsite_sentinel_mask: both Uclk and Fclk call sites pass first stack argument zero, which the reader loads into r7 and uses in sentinel guards
semantics.fclk_type_selector: Fclk passes SP+0x0c as the type-byte pointer but no explicit write to that local occurs in the bounded Fclk body before the reader call; actual type-2 branch execution for this caller is therefore not established
semantics.fclk_context: Fclk handler writes a typed reader result only on reader success; its caller seeds local 0x4b0 before the call and unconditionally stores the resulting halfword to context+0x78; a later static path loads that field and compares against 0x3e8/0x4b0
semantics.numeric_qualification: candidate token IDs 0x15f/0x160 are identifiers; downstream constants 0x3e8/0x4b0 are observed comparison thresholds. The path does not prove a unit conversion or that tokens equal thresholds

fresh_result: Before the final descriptor, helper status R0=0 advances to the next item; helper status R0!=0 advances only if the returned byte equals 1. Any other first-stage byte is terminal failure at 0x209A. On the final descriptor, helper status R0=0 returns failure at 0x2094; helper success with an Auto/sentinel value also fails terminally at 0x209A without another descriptor attempt. Fallback is therefore status/gate driven, while final sentinel handling is terminal value validation. A separate exact static Fclk caller seeds local 0x4b0, calls the halfword reader, and then stores the local to context+0x78; a later context path loads it and compares to 0x3e8/0x4b0. These are threshold constants, not proven equivalents of token IDs 0x15f/0x160.
limits: Exact static bytes only; no runtime/APCB value observation, loader-base proof, frequency units, clock application, training, or hardware result.
